prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Lauren, a fictional 50-year-old, George's second wife and Natalie's stepmother, Cassie's mother; the controlling matriarch of the Quinn mansion; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Polished woman of 50 with a sharp heart-shaped face, a pronounced jaw, arched pencil brows and narrow grey-green eyes. She wears full makeup with bold red lipstick. Shoulder-length honey-blonde hair is set in a sleek, voluminous blow-out. She is slim and upright, about 168 cm. Her jewellery is a large pearl necklace, pearl drop earrings and a diamond wedding ring.. Wearing one outfit only: A fitted crimson-red long-sleeve knee-length sheath dress with a round neckline, a thin gold belt at the waist, nude pointed-toe high heels and a pearl necklace. All plain, with no logos.. Signature colour: red. Expression in the close-up shows: Cold, domineering and status-obsessed. She is contemptuous of Natalie and jealous of George's ex-wife. She reminds George that he owes everything to her, and she delights in her daughter's schemes..
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 50, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
